text: Interactive API reference lets developers make real test calls and see live responses without writing code
quote: developers can explore your API, make test calls right from the documentation, and see real responses without writing a single line of code

text: An MCP server gives AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot) a live connection to the API spec and docs
quote: Your MCP server gives AI coding assistants — Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot — a live connection to your API spec and documentation.

text: Ask AI answers reader questions instantly from the published documentation inside the hub
quote: Ask AI gives your users instant answers from your published documentation, directly inside your hub.

text: Readers can suggest edits or flag typos/feedback directly via GitHub
quote: They can use Suggest in GitHub to flag typos or share user feedback.

text: Custom linter rules can be written in natural language and applied to check every page
quote: You write rules in natural language — like "Use active voice" or "Flag placeholder text" — and it checks every page against them

text: Docs Audit runs all linter rules across every page in one pass to surface outdated content, broken links, and style issues
quote: Docs Audit runs your Linter rules against every page in your project in a single pass, so you can find outdated content, broken links, and style inconsistencies across your entire site

text: A GitHub AI Writer watches pull requests and proposes doc updates when code changes affect the docs
quote: The GitHub AI Writer keeps your documentation in sync with your codebase by watching your pull requests and proposing updates when code changes affect your docs.

text: MCP Analytics tracks every tool call to the MCP server, showing volume, latency, failures, and which endpoint/query was invoked
quote: The MCP page in Analytics shows how many calls arrived, how quickly they returned, how many failed, and the query or endpoint behind each call.

text: ReadMe crawls a sample of published pages and scores the project against an Agent-Friendly Docs spec
quote: ReadMe crawls a sample of your published pages and scores your project against the Agent-Friendly Docs spec

text: Docs content can be written locally or in ReadMe and synced two-way with a connected GitHub/GitLab repository
quote: Bi-directional sync creates a two-way connection between your ReadMe project and a GitHub or GitLab repository.

text: Reviews let teammates check changes with an AI Linter or get approval before publishing
quote: Reviews allow you to check your changes for issues with the AI Linter or get approval from a teammate.

text: Docs (or a PDF) can be exported directly from the Branch menu
quote: You can export the files in your docs or as a PDF from the Branch menu.

text: Docs appearance can be customized via CSS variables or custom CSS rules
quote: Customize your docs with CSS using either CSS variables or custom CSS rules.

text: An OpenAPI spec can be imported by URL, file upload, or drag-and-drop and transformed into interactive documentation
quote: ReadMe makes it simple to transform your existing OAS file into beautiful, interactive documentation that your developers will actually enjoy using.

text: Reusable content blocks can be edited once and the update propagates automatically to every page that uses them
quote: Reusable Content lets ReadMe Admins create Markdown blocks that appear across multiple pages. When you edit a block, the system updates all instances automatically.

text: Multiple versions of documentation can be maintained for different product/API versions
quote: Maintaining multiple versions of your documentation is critical for many different technical products.

text: A built-in AI Agent creates, edits, and enhances content across Guides, API References, and Custom Pages via natural-language prompts
quote: When you select text, a prompt field appears in the formatting toolbar where you can type plain-language instructions and let the Agent apply the edits.

text: Docs can be hosted on a custom company domain via project configuration
quote: Hosting docs on your company domain is an important part of making your docs polished and professional. You can setup a custom domain from **Configuration** > **Custom Domain**.

text: API Metrics report call volume, endpoint usage, and errors for insight into API usage
quote: With ReadMe's API Metrics, you have reports on API call volume, endpoint usage, and errors that give you insights into your best use cases
